robot.name: EngineAI T800
robot.status_notes: Officially launched 2025-12-02 with pricing from 180,000 yuan and four versions. First batch rolled off production line 2026-05-29 and mass delivery was announced. No public retail checkout or named customer deployment was found. addoobot lists the robot as commercially available.

height.notes: Official launch press release says 1.73m; official site lists 173CM.

weight.notes: Official launch press release says optimized self-weight of 75kg. addoobot technical specifications list 84.5 kg; the official value is used and the conflict is kept in researcher_notes.

payload.notes: addoobot lists max payload as 5 kg per arm. No official payload figure was found in EngineAI sources.

runtime.notes: Official press release claims stable 4-5 hour runtime. addoobot lists average runtime as 2 hours; this conflict is noted in researcher_notes.

battery.notes: EngineAI claims the industry's first high-performance solid-state power battery for humanoid robots. addoobot lists a removable ternary lithium battery with 1.22 kWh capacity; this conflict is not used as primary.

degrees_of_freedom.notes: Official site lists 29-DOF total excluding the dexterous hand. addoobot describes Basic 25 DoF body, Pro 43 total DoF including hands, Max 46 total DoF including hands; no official total including hand was found in EngineAI sources.

walking_speed.notes: addoobot lists max locomotion speed as 1.5 m/s. No official walking speed was found in EngineAI sources.

hands.description: EngineAI describes a fully self-developed multi-dimensional sensing dexterous hand with biomimetic design, tactile sensing systems and precise force control. Pro and Max configurations offer seven degrees of freedom per hand according to addoobot.
hands.force_feedback: tactile sensing and precise force control (company claim)

compute.description: addoobot lists Basic with Orin NX 16 GB, Developer/Pro with NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin 64 GB, and Max with 5G connectivity. No official compute disclosure was found in EngineAI sources.

actuators.description: EngineAI claims a full-stack integrated joint module with peak torque of 450 N·m and instantaneous 14,000 W peak joint power. addoobot lists high-speed internal-rotor permanent magnet synchronous motors. Full-joint active cooling system for legs is claimed.

availability.notes: Official launch states T800 priced from 180,000 yuan with Base, Ecosystem, Pro and Max versions. Purchase path is contact sales; no online checkout or public waitlist was found.

manipulation_dexterity.summary: EngineAI claims a self-developed dexterous hand with tactile sensing and force control, and addoobot describes Pro/Max configurations with seven degrees of freedom per hand. A CES 2026 press release mentions live demonstrations of T800 full-body coordination and fine motor control, but no specific fine-manipulation task success rates or video transcripts were reviewed.
caveats: No independent dexterity benchmark or success rates.
Video content beyond titles was not reviewed; no transcript available.

autonomy_task_execution.summary: EngineAI claims AI-powered intelligent path planning and millisecond-level environmental modeling. addoobot lists operation as semi-autonomous and teleoperation. No autonomous task completion, intervention logs, or success rate was found.
caveats: Autonomy is company-claimed only.
No autonomous task demo or independent audit.

mobility_whole_body_control.summary: Official claims include 450 N·m peak torque, 14,000 W instantaneous joint peak power, and high-dynamic scenarios like martial arts and running. A CES 2026 press release describes live demonstrations of full-body coordination. Public video titles from EngineAI and third parties reference T800 dynamic moves and CGI rumor rebuttals, but no video content was reviewed.
caveats: No fall-rate or disturbance recovery data.
Video titles only; no transcript or independent measurement.

perception_scene_understanding.summary: EngineAI claims a 360-degree omnidirectional LiDAR system enabling millisecond-level environmental modeling and AI path planning for obstacle avoidance. addoobot describes binocular cameras on development configurations.
caveats: No third-party perception benchmark or obstacle avoidance demo detail.

human_interaction.summary: Official press release describes a dynamic interactive light strip with multi-mode lighting language to display device status and interaction commands, enhancing human-machine collaboration. No conversational AI or instruction-following demonstration was found.
caveats: No demonstrated conversational reliability or natural language interaction.

endurance_reliability.summary: EngineAI claims a 4-5 hour solid-state battery runtime and a full-joint active cooling system for legs. The Shenzhen manufacturing base press release states each robot passes 79 full-dimensional quality inspections and 46 working condition simulation tests before delivery, with a new robot rolling off the line every 15 minutes. addoobot lists a conflicting average runtime of 2 hours.
caveats: Runtime conflict between 4-5 hours official and 2 hours directory.
Production/test counts are company-reported; no independent audit.

human_environment_fit.summary: Official launch describes a 1.73m, 75kg humanoid with ergonomic design, biomimetic noise-resistant foot, anti-slip wear-resistant components, and an interactive light strip. addoobot warns users to maintain safe distances from the high-power drive system.
caveats: No third-party safety certification of the full robot was found.
Powerful joints and heavy weight raise safety concerns.

deployment_commercial_proof.summary: The May 2026 press release announces the first batch of T800 robots rolling off the Shenzhen production line and mass delivery, with a 10,000-unit scalable delivery capability. No named external customer, operating hours, or output metrics were found.
caveats: No named customer deployment or external use case metrics.
Production and delivery claims are company-reported.

accessibility_value.summary: Official launch states T800 is priced from 180,000 yuan with four versions (Base, Ecosystem, Pro, Max). Official site links to a product page. Purchase path is contact sales; no online checkout or waitlist was found.
caveats: Price is from the Base version; higher versions cost more.
No independent verification of actual transaction prices or availability.

evidence_items.claim: T800 delivers peak torque of 450 N·m and instantaneous 14,000 W peak joint power through integrated joint modules.
evidence_items.notes: Official launch and CES press release; not independently measured.

Its instantaneous 14,000W peak power joint, combined with multi-degree-of-freedom joints in critical areas like the neck, waist, and hands, enables highly anthropomorphic flexibility.

evidence_items.notes: Directory aggregation; conflicts with official weight and runtime.
evidence_items.arena_relevance: Conflicting specs should lower confidence in official endurance.
evidence_items.verification_notes: Not independently verified; likely based on different configuration or prototype.

evidence_items.source_location: addoobot, Four versions for different needs

researcher_notes.short_verdict_for_arena: EngineAI T800 is a full-size humanoid with strong official high-torque and production claims, but evidence is dominated by company sources. No named customer deployment or independent verification was found. Spec conflicts reduce confidence in endurance and weight.
strongest_positive_evidence: Official launch with price from 180,000 yuan and four versions.
450 N·m peak torque and 14,000 W peak joint power claims repeated at CES 2026.
CES live demonstrations of full-body coordination and fine motor control.
May 2026 mass production first batch and 10,000-unit scalable delivery claim.
79 quality inspections and 46 working condition tests per robot before delivery.
weakest_or_missing_evidence: No named customer deployment or external use case metrics.
No autonomous task execution or intervention logs.
No independent benchmark for mobility, manipulation, or perception.
Video contents not reviewed; only titles available.
conflicting_claims: Weight: 75 kg official vs 84.5 kg addoobot.
Runtime: 4-5 hours official vs 2 hours addoobot.
Battery type: solid-state official vs removable ternary lithium addoobot.
Walking speed: 1.5 m/s addoobot only; not in official sources.
do_not_overclaim: Do not credit any specific customer deployment.
Do not treat production line cadence as proof of field reliability.
Do not credit autonomous task execution; addoobot lists semi-autonomous/teleoperation.
Do not describe video content beyond titles; no transcript reviewed.
Do not use addoobot conflicting specs as primary.

arena_prompt_summary.one_paragraph_summary: EngineAI T800 is a full-size bipedal humanoid (1.73 m, 75 kg official) with 29 body DoF excluding dexterous hand, 450 N·m peak joint torque, and a claimed 4-5 hour solid-state battery runtime. It launched on 2025-12-02 from 180,000 yuan with four versions and was demonstrated at CES 2026. In May 2026, EngineAI announced mass production with first batch delivery and a 10,000-unit scalable capability. However, all strong evidence is company-reported. No named customer deployment, autonomous task execution, or independent verification was found. addoobot lists conflicting specs (84.5 kg, 2 h runtime, 1.22 kWh ternary battery) that lower confidence in endurance.
strongest_evidence: Official launch with price and four versions (engineai-t800_evidence_001).
CES 2026 live demonstrations of full-body coordination and fine motor control (engineai-t800_evidence_009).
May 2026 mass production first batch and 10,000-unit delivery capability (engineai-t800_evidence_011).
79 quality inspections and 46 working condition tests before delivery (engineai-t800_evidence_012).
weakest_evidence: No named customer or deployment metrics.
Spec conflicts on weight, runtime, and battery type.
No video content reviewed; only titles.
known_do_not_credit: addoobot conflicting specs as primary values.
